title: Numbers with Fluctuating Streaks
scenario: Identify numbers that have at least two separate streaks of 3+ consecutive occurrences. Return 'num'.
hint: Count how many islands of size >= 3 exist for each number.
correctQuery: SELECT num FROM (SELECT num, COUNT(*) AS streak_count FROM (SELECT num, COUNT(*) as s FROM (SELECT id, num, id - ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY num ORDER BY id)::INT AS grp FROM logs) t GROUP BY num, grp HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3) t2 GROUP BY num) t3 WHERE streak_count >= 2;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE logs (id INT, num VARCHAR); INSERT INTO logs VALUES (1, '1'), (2, '1'), (3, '1'), (4, '2'), (5, '1'), (6, '1'), (7, '1');
